limitations: Backtest numbers are not a claim of a live edge; only settled ledger rows can make that claim.
Ratings use final margins only: no injuries, quarterbacks, travel or weather. The stacked layer adds rest, back-to-backs and (MLB) probable-pitcher adjustments on top.
Home advantage is a single learned constant per fit; it does not vary by team or drift inside a season.
Archived lines are one consensus number per game (effectively closing), so backtest selections are graded at the close; closing-line value is measured live through the ledger.
The independent model trails the market on margin MAE (10.8798 vs 10.4425); treat it as a sanity check on the market, not a replacement for it.
NBA: lines are ESPN per-game multi-book medians from the 2015-16 season. Regular season, play-in and playoff games are included; the 2020 bubble games are not flagged neutral by ESPN.
